description: Check whether florist delivery is available to a US ZIP code on one specific date. Availability is per ZIP and date, not per arrangement. Same-day delivery requires ordering before 1:00 PM in the recipient's local time zone, Monday through Saturday. When a date is unavailable, the result includes a reason (Sunday, past date or past the same-day cutoff) when one is known.

date.description: Requested delivery date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the recipient's local date.

name: check_delivery
title: Check delivery on a date
